```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(leafem)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Load CSV mangrove planted data
BRGM_rehab <- read_csv("BRGM_planted_mangrove.csv")

# Clean 'hectares' to numeric (remove commas/spaces)
BRGM_rehab <- BRGM_rehab %>%
  mutate(hectares_num = as.numeric(gsub("[,\\s]", "", hectares)))

# Summarize total hectares and years by province
location_summary <- BRGM_rehab %>%
  group_by(Province) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hectare = sum(hectares_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    years = paste(sort(unique(year)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(province_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(Province)))

# Read new province shapefile and transform CRS
province_sf <- st_read("INDO_PROV.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Fix invalid geometries
province_sf_valid <- sf::st_make_valid(province_sf)

# If multiple polygons per province, dissolve here (optional)
# For this shapefile, if already province-level polygons, this may not be needed

# Clean province name column for join
province_sf_valid <- province_sf_valid %>%
  mutate(province_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(nmprov)))

# Join CSV summary data to province polygons by cleaned name
joined_sf <- province_sf_valid %>%
  left_join(location_summary, by = "province_clean")

# Replace NA values with defaults for mapping
joined_sf$total_hectare[is.na(joined_sf$total_hectare)] <- 0
joined_sf$years[is.na(joined_sf$years)] <- "No data"

# Create color palette for total hectares
pal <- colorNumeric("Blues", domain = joined_sf$total_hectare, na.color = "lightgrey")

# Build Leaflet map
map_BRGM <- leaflet(joined_sf) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(total_hectare),
    color = "blue",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", nmprov, "</b><br>",
      "Years: ", years, "<br>",
      "Total Planted Area: ", format(total_hectare, big.mark = ","), " Hectares"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~total_hectare,
    title = "Planted Area (Hectares)",
    opacity = 0.7
  ) %>%
  addMouseCoordinates() %>%
  addMiniMap(tiles = providers$OpenStreetMap, position = "bottomleft")

map_BRGM

library(htmlwidgets)

# Assuming your leaflet map object is named 'map'
saveWidget(map_BRGM, file = "index.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

# Save the widget with external supporting files directory
saveWidget(map_BRGM,
           file = "index.html",
           selfcontained = TRUE,
           libdir = "BRGM_files")

```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(leafem)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Load CSV mangrove planted data
BRGM_rehab <- read_csv("BRGM_planted_mangrove.csv")

# Clean 'hectares' to numeric (remove commas/spaces)
BRGM_rehab <- BRGM_rehab %>%
  mutate(hectares_num = as.numeric(gsub("[,\\s]", "", hectares)))

# Summarize total hectares and years by province
location_summary <- BRGM_rehab %>%
  group_by(Province) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hectare = sum(hectares_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    years = paste(sort(unique(year)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(province_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(Province)))

# Read province shapefile and transform CRS
province_sf <- st_read("INDO_PROV.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Fix invalid geometries and clean province name for join
province_sf_valid <- sf::st_make_valid(province_sf) %>%
  mutate(province_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(nmprov)))

# Join CSV summary data to province polygons by cleaned name
joined_sf <- province_sf_valid %>%
  left_join(location_summary, by = "province_clean")

# Replace NA values with defaults for mapping
joined_sf$total_hectare[is.na(joined_sf$total_hectare)] <- 0
joined_sf$years[is.na(joined_sf$years)] <- "No data"

# Create color palette for total hectares
pal <- colorNumeric("Blues", domain = joined_sf$total_hectare, na.color = "lightgrey")

# Compute centroids for each province polygon
centroids <- st_centroid(joined_sf)
coords <- st_coordinates(centroids)

# Build Leaflet map using province centroids
map_BRGM_centroid <- leaflet(centroids) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = coords[, 1],
    lat = coords[, 2],
    radius = 8,
    fillColor = ~pal(total_hectare),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "blue",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~nmprov,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", nmprov, "</b><br>",
      "Years: ", years, "<br>",
      "Total Planted Area: ", format(total_hectare, big.mark = ","), " Hectares"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~total_hectare,
    title = "Planted Area (Hectares)",
    opacity = 0.7
  ) %>%
  addMouseCoordinates() %>%
  addMiniMap(tiles = providers$OpenStreetMap, position = "bottomleft")

# Render map in RStudio/viewer
map_BRGM_centroid

# Export static or interactive html widget
saveWidget(map_BRGM_centroid, file = "index_centroid.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
saveWidget(map_BRGM_centroid, file = "index_centroid.html", selfcontained = TRUE, libdir = "BRGM_files")

```


```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(maps)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)   # For palettes

# Load data (similar to your previous code)
# Assuming joined_sf includes province polygons and total_hectare

# Define color palette - Blues from RColorBrewer instead of viridis
pal_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(100)

# Calculate province polygon areas (optional, can standardize colors by area)
joined_sf <- joined_sf %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6)  # convert m2 to km2

# Color scale domain can be adjusted - here by total_hectare absolute or ratio to area
color_domain <- range(joined_sf$total_hectare, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create color indices for each polygon according to total_hectare
color_indices <- findInterval(joined_sf$total_hectare, seq(color_domain[1], color_domain[2], length.out = 100))

# Set up plot region and background as your example
min_lon <- 90; max_lon <- 150
min_lat <- -15; max_lat <- 15

pdf("BRGM_mangrove_rehabilitation_21-23.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)
old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
plot(NA, xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
     type = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
rect(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat, col = "lightblue", border = NA)
map("world", xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
    col = "grey85", fill = TRUE, add = TRUE)
abline(v = seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)
abline(h = seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)
axis(1, at = seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), labels = paste0(seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), "°E"), cex.axis = 0.7)
axis(2, at = seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4), labels = paste0(abs(seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4)), 
     ifelse(seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4) < 0, "°S", "°N")), cex.axis = 0.7)

# Plot provinces polygons colored by total_hectare
plot(st_geometry(joined_sf), col = pal_colors[color_indices], border = "blue", add = TRUE)

# Legend (color gradient bar) - custom similar to your example
colorbar_x <- max_lon - 10
colorbar_y_bottom <- min_lat + 2
colorbar_y_top <- colorbar_y_bottom + 8

rect(colorbar_x - 0.2, colorbar_y_bottom - 0.2, colorbar_x + 3.5, colorbar_y_top + 1, col = "white", border = NA)
legend_image <- as.raster(matrix(rev(pal_colors), ncol = 1))
rasterImage(legend_image, colorbar_x, colorbar_y_bottom, colorbar_x + 1, colorbar_y_top)
text(colorbar_x + 2, seq(colorbar_y_bottom, colorbar_y_top, length.out = 5),
     labels = round(seq(color_domain[1], color_domain[2], length.out = 5)), cex = 0.7, adj = 0)
text(colorbar_x + 0.5, colorbar_y_top + 0.8, "Planted Area (Hectares)", cex = 0.8)

# Scale bar and north arrow (as in your example)
scalebar_length <- 200
scalebar_x <- min_lon + 1
scalebar_y <- min_lat + 1
rect(scalebar_x, scalebar_y, scalebar_x + 2, scalebar_y + 0.2, col = "black")
text(scalebar_x + 1, scalebar_y - 0.4, paste0(scalebar_length, " km"), adj = 0.5, cex = 0.7)
north_x <- max_lon - 1.5
north_N_y <- max_lat - 1
text(north_x, north_N_y, "N", cex = 1.1, font = 2)

par(old_par)
dev.off()

```
